title: Design System: SIPU Swiss-Belinn SKA Pekanbaru

body.purpose: Standard table cells, form inputs, notes.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for button and state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for key triggers and submissions in Swiss-Belinn Red.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #E31B23; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C4141B; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #A30F15; transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary button for filters, cancels, and non-destructive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; border-color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions such as deleting items or rejecting requests.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #ef4444; color: #ffffff; border: none; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: background-color 0.15s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #dc2626; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form text input with Swiss-Belinn Red focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-text { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; color: #0f172a; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input-text:focus { border-color: #E31B23; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(227, 27, 35, 0.2); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic pill badge for status indication.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); }

narrative.overview: SIPU (Sistem Informasi Pengelolaan Usaha) is the operational pulse of Swiss-Belinn SKA Pekanbaru. The interface embodies the professionalism, warmth, and high standard of international hospitality operations. Every interaction is structured, clean, and immediately decipherable by hotel staff across all shifts.
keyCharacteristics: Decisive Swiss-Belinn Red (#E31B23) commands attention for key actions, status highlights, and active states without visual noise.
Harmonized Component Geometry: unified rounded corners (rounded-xl for cards and buttons, rounded-lg for inputs).
Scannable Typography: Standardized Inter type hierarchy with legible weights.
Consistent Icon Grammar: inline SVG icons standardized at 16px or 20px with matching stroke widths.

rules.name: The Single Brand Voice Rule
rules.body: Swiss-Belinn Red (#E31B23) is reserved exclusively for the primary action on a view, active navigation links, and brand emblems.

rules.name: The Semantic Status Rule
rules.body: Colors outside the brand red and neutral scale are strictly semantic: emerald for success, amber for pending/warning, rose for danger/rejection, sky for info.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: All numeric counters, clock-in times, currency amounts, and dates in tables must use tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Border-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Every elevated container must have a crisp border (border border-slate-200/80). Shadows accompany borders, never replace them.

dos: Do use Swiss-Belinn Red (#E31B23) as the sole primary action color across all views.
Do ensure all interactive buttons use rounded-xl with consistent height and padding.
Do accompany button icons with mr-2 w-4 h-4 and ensure vertical alignment with text.
Do use standard semantic color badges for status representations.
donts: Don't use arbitrary colors (bg-blue-600, bg-purple-600, bg-indigo-600) for primary buttons.
Don't mix corner radius styles on the same view.
Don't make secondary buttons look like disabled primary buttons.
Don't use pure black text (#000000); use slate-900 (#0F172A) for headers and slate-600 (#475569) for body copy.
